name: Doktomy
author: mbtmedia

sections.description:
Doktomy is a powerful WordPress plugin that integrates with the Doktomy.com platform, allowing you to:

  • Generate documents – Automatically generate PDF and DOCX documents based on form submissions
  • Document templates – Manage and customize document templates
  • Create and manage forms – Build custom forms with drag-and-drop interface
  • Download filled-in documents – Download ready-to-sign documents with data provided by user
  • Send emails – Send completed documents to user after completing form
  • API Integration – Seamlessly connect with Doktomy API for document processing
  • Email templates – Configure email templates with custom tags

  • Header and footer – Create company documents header and footer templates

  • User-friendly interface – Intuitive admin dashboard with clear navigation

The plugin provides a complete solution for document generation and form management, perfect for businesses that need to automate document creation workflows.

Key Features

  • Form Builder – Create unlimited forms with customizable fields
  • Shortcode Support – Easy embedding of forms anywhere on your site
  • Email Tags – Dynamic placeholders for personalized emails
  • Document Management – Track and manage all generated documents
  • Secure API Integration – Encrypted storage of API credentials
  • Translation Ready – Full i18n support with included Polish translation

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.2 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Active Doktomy.com platform account and API key

Additional Information

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please contact us at Doktomy.com

Public source code repository: https://bitbucket.org/mbt-media-wordpress-projects/doktomy/

External Service

This plugin uses the Doktomy.com platform API to generate PDF or DOCX documents and optionally send email notifications based on form submissions. PDF and DOCX creation service is provided by Doktomy.com and is essential for the document-generation workflow.

The plugin connects to Doktomy.com when:

  • a user submits a form created in WordPress
  • the plugin retrieves document templates, headers, footers, and email templates from the Doktomy service
  • the plugin validates the configured API key

The following data may be transmitted to Doktomy:

  • form field values submitted by the user
  • form identifier and selected template identifier
  • email address used for notifications (if enabled)
  • document description and metadata
  • the configured Doktomy API key used to authenticate requests

The exact payload depends on the form configuration and selected document/email template settings.

Privacy Policy and Service Regulations

  • Doktomy.com Privacy Policy
  • Doktomy.com service Terms of Use

Please ensure your users are informed about data processing and update your own privacy policy if you use this plugin in production.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Doktomy”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. After installation, click “Activate Plugin”

Configuration

  1. After activation, go to Doktomy in the WordPress admin menu
  2. Navigate to the Settings tab
  3. Enter your Doktomy.com API Key
  4. Save settings
  5. You’re ready to create forms and generate documents!
sections.faq:
Do I need a Doktomy account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need an active Doktomy.com platform account and API key to use the document generation features. The API key is required for communication with the Doktomy service.

How do I get a Doktomy API key?

Visit the Doktomy.com platform to obtain your API key. Once you have it, enter it in the plugin settings page.

Can I create unlimited forms?

Yes, you can create as many forms as you need. There are no limitations on the number of forms in the plugin itself.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is fully internationalized and includes Polish translation. You can add more translations using standard WordPress i18n tools.

How do I embed a form on my page?

After creating a form, copy the provided shortcode (e.g., [doktomy_form id="123"]) and paste it into any post, page, or widget area where you want the form to appear.

Are API credentials stored securely?

Yes, the API key is encrypted before being stored in the WordPress database for enhanced security.

Can I customize email notifications?

Yes, the plugin includes an email template editor with support for dynamic tags that are replaced with form submission data.
